title: Anxiety | Gurleen Pannu | Standup Comedy
description:
MY UK- EUROPE TOUR is LIVE!
Click on this link and catch me in your city: https://linktr.ee/pannugurleen

I'm excited to present another  #standupcomedy  video on Youtube! Haan aa gya yaad password…
My name is Gurleen Pannu, join me as I share my experiences about ghabrahat #standupcomedian   and my family  (the anxious people)  and the amazing time we spend anxiously around our house ,entertaining each other.
Share the video with your friends & family.
